currentWave.title: Wave 1
currentWave.summary: Our first open wave of grants supports teams building privacy-preserving payment infrastructure with Wraith Protocol. Funding is provided by the Stellar Development Foundation through the Drips program, with additional support from external contributors.
currentWave.howToApply: Submit a short proposal via the Drips platform describing your project, how it integrates Wraith, and the expected impact. Proposals are reviewed on a rolling basis.
eligibility: Open to individuals and teams worldwide
Project must integrate Wraith Protocol SDK or contracts
Open-source code preferred but not required for early-stage POCs
Teams building on Stellar, EVM chains, Solana, or CKB are all eligible
reviewCriteria: Technical feasibility and integration depth with Wraith
Potential impact on the stealth-payments ecosystem
Team experience and ability to ship

rewardTiers.description: Novel privacy tooling, SDK contributions, or ecosystem infrastructure

faq.question: Who is eligible for a Wraith grant?
faq.answer: Anyone building privacy-preserving payment infrastructure that integrates with Wraith Protocol. We welcome individuals, teams, and organizations from any jurisdiction, provided they can receive funding through the Drips platform.

faq.question: What kind of projects get funded?
faq.answer: We fund SDK integrations, wallet adapters, demo applications, developer tooling, documentation, security audits, and novel privacy research that extends Wraith's capabilities. If it helps more people use stealth addresses, we're interested.

faq.question: How are grants reviewed?
faq.answer: Proposals are reviewed by the Wraith core team and SDF representatives against four criteria: technical feasibility, ecosystem impact, team capability, and clarity of deliverables. Reviews happen on a rolling basis during an active wave.

faq.question: How and when do I receive funds?
faq.answer: Grants are distributed through the Drips platform in milestone-based installments. After your proposal is accepted, you define 2–4 milestones with the review committee. Funds are released as each milestone is completed and verified.

faq.question: Do I need to open-source my project?
faq.answer: Open-source is strongly preferred and required for funding above the Explorer tier. For smaller POC grants, we can accommodate teams that plan to open-source at a later stage.

faq.question: What is Drips and how does it relate to Wraith?
faq.answer: Drips is a continuous-funding platform that enables transparent, streaming grant disbursements. The Stellar Development Foundation uses Drips to distribute its Stellar Wave program funds. Wraith's grant program is a sub-program of Stellar Wave, meaning SDF funds flow to grantees through Drips.

faq.question: Can I apply if I am already funded by another program?
faq.answer: Yes. We do not require exclusivity. If your project benefits the Wraith ecosystem, we encourage you to apply regardless of other funding sources.

faq.question: How long does the review process take?
faq.answer: Initial review typically takes 2–3 weeks. If your proposal is shortlisted, you will be invited to a 30-minute call with the review committee to discuss scope, milestones, and deliverables before a final decision.
